findings.title: Registered metric alert handler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` inherits `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of its abstract methods, including `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the new occurrence hook. When a detector with this registered group type accesses `detector_handler`, instantiation raises `TypeError` instead of returning a handler, so processing that detector fails.

findings.title: Evaluation docstring still describes a list return value
findings.body: This method now returns a dictionary keyed by group key, but its docstring says it returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`. That contradicts the method's contract and can mislead callers implementing or debugging detector handlers.
